evidenceNote: A generic eight-thruster vectored ROV/AUV (BlueROV2-Heavy-like) from published literature and vendor numbers only. Nothing here was identified on a vehicle; it is an example card for the public reference mission.

bluerobotics_t200_page.citation: Blue Robotics T200 product page: 12 V 3.71/2.92 kgf, 16 V 5.25/4.10 kgf, 20 V 6.7/5.05 kgf (forward/reverse)

crane_derived.citation: Derived in this profile from the cited primary values; derivation in "location".

weightN.location: W = m g = 13.5 * 9.82 (von Benzon eq. 8 definition W = mg)

buoyancyN.location: B = rho g nabla = 1000 * 9.82 * 0.0134 (von Benzon eq. 8 definition). Net W - B = +0.98 N (slightly heavy).

u.location: Table A1, X_udot (Eidsvik empirical, ref [33]; paper sec. 2 notes relative error vs physical robot)

maxForwardN.location: von Benzon eq. 18 F(V) at V=+1: -140.3+389.9-404.1+176.0+8.9 = 30.4 N. Consistent with Table 4: 4*30.4*cos(45deg) = 86 N surge (paper 85 N), 4*30.4 = 122 N heave (paper 120 N).

maxReverseN.location: 0.78 x 30.4 N: T200 reverse/forward ratio 4.10/5.25 = 0.781 at 16 V (2.92/3.71 = 0.787 at 12 V) applied to the von Benzon eq. 18 forward maximum

value.form: odd polynomial in normalised command V in [-1,1]

timeConstantS.location: 63 % rise time of the unit-step response of von Benzon eq. 19 (poles -13.16, -37.9 +- 82.6j; zero -17.7; no overshoot), computed with python -I. First-order surrogate only.

uncertainty.note: 0.020 s from eq. 19 is optimistic for ESC+motor spin-up; sweep to 0.10 s

deadbandFraction.location: 25 us / 400 us half-range (Basic ESC deadband 1500 +- 25 us)

layout.location: Table 4.2 (arms, mm) and p.41 rotation angles pi/4, -pi/4, -3pi/4, 3pi/4 with Fx = F cos(a), Fy = -F sin(a). Positions match von Benzon Table A1 r_i = J3(alpha_i)[0.156 0.111 0.085], alpha = {0, 5.05, 1.91, pi}, and r_5..8 = J3(gamma_i)[0.120 0.218 0]. Vertical direction [0,0,-1] is from von Benzon Table A1. Aft horizontal pair mirrored to the forward pair (T3 [-0.707, -0.707, 0], T4 [-0.707, 0.707, 0]) per ardusub_frames SUB_FRAME_VECTORED_6DOF factors: equal yaw arms 0.189 m, max sway 86 N = max surge. Propeller handedness: not modelled (positive command = direction).

dimensionsLxHxWM.location: L 0.46 and W 0.58 (Heavy) from vonbenzon2022 Table 5; H 0.254 from Blue Robotics spec. von Benzon prints H = 0.38, inconsistent with its own A_v = 0.1131 m2 ~ L x 0.25 m
